title: Counter Note on the Price a New Piece Is Taken At
content:
1. In working out the credit put toward a sale under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, the price of the new piece is read as the least the customer must spend that the registration records.

2. Where the customer's loyalty account under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme carries a merchandise sale for the current month and cover for a piece stands quoted on their file, the price of the new piece is read as the spend that account records against its most recent merchandise sale.

3. Where that account carries no merchandise sale for the current month but cover for a piece stands quoted, the price of the new piece is read as the value the quoted cover records for the piece.

4. A merchandise sale for the current month is a loyalty account entry in the merchandise earning category dated within the month ending on the handling date, and the spend it records is the qualifying spend on that entry; where several stand, the most recent governs. Cover stands quoted where a plan on the customer's file under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is at the quoted standing, and the value it records for the piece is the value the piece was taken in at on that plan.

| Merchandise sale on the loyalty account this month | Cover quoted on the file | Price of the new piece read as |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the spend on the most recent merchandise sale |
| no | yes | the value the quoted cover records for the piece |
| yes | no | the least the customer must spend on the registration |
| no | no | the least the customer must spend on the registration |

Taking a registration that records the least the customer must spend as 9000 USD, a loyalty account carrying a merchandise sale this month with a qualifying spend of 11500 USD, and a quoted cover on the file recording the piece at 10000 USD: with both standing as described the price is 11500 USD; with the quoted cover but no merchandise sale this month it is 10000 USD; with the merchandise sale but no quoted cover it is 9000 USD.
